newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan C.bank injects 260 mln dirhams at auction.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan C.bank injects 260 mln dirhams at auction.

text.p: The Moroccan Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) injected 260 million dirhams in the money market for one week at its repurchase auction on Wednesday, a bank official said.
The bank said it received bids totalling 4.018 billion dirhams and allocated 2.884 billion dirhams at seven percent interest rate for one week.
The amount allocated was less than 2.624 billion dirhams leaving the market this week, it said.
The bank satisfied 71.78 percent of demand.
The next auction is due to be held on September 25, 1996.
